EGY.note: A child-protection AI policy is said to be in preparation but no draft is published and nothing is in force.

facts.fact: MCIT adviser Huda Baraka says more than 40 AI applications are already in use in various government bodies.
MCIT adviser Huda Baraka says more than 40 AI applications are in use across different government bodies, and a number of ministries and agencies have begun using small language models.

EGY.note: A generative AI policy for government and a procurement guide are discussed or being prepared, not issued.
No sector system using AI is named.

facts.fact: MCIT adviser Huda Baraka says Egypt works under the second edition of its national AI strategy, launched in January 2025.

The National Council for AI (now for AI, Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies), created in 2019, recently discussed the report of the strategy's achievements for the first half of 2026, per MCIT adviser Huda Baraka.

EGY.note: No locally built model, dataset or AI computing is named.
Only a policy against putting sensitive government data into public generative AI tools; no data protection law status is stated.
